usage: deskops promote [-h] {inbox-to-drawer-task} ...

positional arguments:
  {inbox-to-drawer-task}
    inbox-to-drawer-task
                        Promote one inbox note into a deferred drawer task candidate.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit

Examples:
  deskops promote inbox-to-drawer-task 20260614-unclear --root .

Selectors accept an exact id, filename, stem, or unique slug fragment where supported.
